summary.name: Tavily
summary.one_liner: Tavily is a real-time web search and content extraction API that gives AI agents live, structured, chunked web data.
use_cases: grounding AI agents with current web facts
reducing LLM hallucinations with live search
extracting relevant content from web pages for models
account research and company data lookup
adding web search to chatbots or agents
summary.what_it_does: Tavily provides APIs that retrieve live web data, extract relevant content, and return it structured and chunked so models can reason over current facts. It describes a retrieval stack with real-time search, caching, and indexing intended to keep latency predictable as traffic grows. Requests pass through security, privacy, and content validation layers that the page says block PII leakage, prompt injection, and malicious sources. The page cites a customer case (Rox) reporting description accuracy rising from 20% to 100% after adding web search, and lists 99.99% uptime and 180 ms latency among its claims.
notable: Returns live web content structured and chunked for LLM consumption
Security, privacy, and content validation layers against PII leakage and prompt injection
Real-time search with caching and indexing for predictable latency
Customer benchmark claims: 100% description accuracy vs 20% before, 99.99% uptime, 180 ms latency (vendor-reported)
caveats: Performance and accuracy figures are vendor-reported on the page and not independently verified
Pricing and plan details are not stated on the page
